pages.text: $(italic)Magic investment. Best for Archmage, Battlemage and Void Summoner.$()$(br2)28 nodes: an 8-node trunk, then two branches of 10, each ending in a capstone. Every node costs 1 point, the capstones too.$(br2)The attribute nodes apply at once. Mana Flow, Spell Haste and Mana Efficiency take effect within 10 seconds.

pages.title: Trunk
pages.text: $(bold)Arcane Power$() I and II: +5% magic damage each$(br2)$(bold)Mana Flow$() I and II: +3% mana regeneration each$(br2)$(bold)Spell Haste$() I and II: +3% cooldown reduction each. Casting itself is no faster.$(br2)$(bold)Arcane Shield$() I and II: +4% magic resistance each

pages.title: Destruction Branch
pages.text: $(bold)Overwhelming Power$() I to IV: +6%, +8%, +8% and +10% magic damage$(br)$(bold)Arcane Penetration$() I to III: +4% magic resistance shred each$(br)$(bold)Mana Efficiency$() I and II: +2.5% spell power each. Spells cost the same mana.$(br2)$(bold)Capstone: Arcane Supremacy$(), +15% magic damage, +8% magic resistance shred and +2.5% spell power.

pages.title: Support Branch
pages.text: $(bold)Restorative Touch$() I to III: +8% healing received each$(br)$(bold)Minion Mastery$() I to III: +8%, +8% and +10% damage by your tamed animals; Iron's Spellbooks summons get nothing$(br)$(bold)Soul Bond$() I: your tamed animals take 8% less damage$(br)$(bold)Extended Influence$() I and II: next page$(br2)$(bold)Capstone: Grand Enchantment$(), +12% healing received, +12% tamed animal damage and a stronger Extended Influence.

pages.title: Extended Influence
pages.text: Every 5 seconds, each beneficial effect on you that has between 5 seconds and 5 minutes left is lengthened by a share of the time it has left: 2.5% with Extended Influence I, 5% with II, and 10% once you also have Grand Enchantment.$(br2)An effect is only lengthened when that share comes to more than a second.
